jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.build: a carved pumpkin (or a Deep Aether carved squash) on a block of enchanted gravitite standing on holystone. It sits where it was built, and hands its builder a storage pebble.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.comparato: reads how full its network's storage is.
Comparator facing the block under a golem:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.crate: are each for either equipment (armour, tools and weapons) or the odds and ends, never both. Equipment gets the crates it needs first, and the odds and ends the rest, up to what a crate holds.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.drawers: are bulk storage. Each drawer keeps what it holds; an empty one is given whatever fills the most stacks. A locked empty drawer is left alone, and a compacting drawer is only ever filled.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.dye: recolours it. Golems of one colour sitting within reach of each other work as one network, up to %s; one more rests until there is room.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.dye.title: Dye on the golem:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.frames: makes it the home for that item and its family.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.frames.st: it holds only that item, and everything else is moved out.
Glow item frame on a chest:
it holds only that item, and everything else is moved out. A Create filter there (or in any frame) stands for everything it lets through.
Glow item frame or Create placard on a chest:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.funnels: link the funnel, and the golem keeps the machine fed with what the funnel's filter lets through. No filter, nothing is fed; redstone on the funnel holds it shut.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.hand: take a pebble. Sneak to switch between Tidy (families of items kept together) and Compact (everything in as few chests as it fits).
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.health: a golem heals slowly while sitting at home. Struck, it pushes everything around it away.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.intro: Gravitite golems sort storage by telekinesis. What they answer to:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.pebble.go: link all the storage within its reach. Sneak to unlink it all.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.pebble.se: send the golem to sit there.
Sneak, pebble on the top of a block:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.pebble.st: link it, or unlink it, without opening it. Hoppers and depots are only ever emptied. Look at linked storage with Jade to see what it is kept for.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.redstone: power makes the golem rest; a pulse has it sort everything again.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.search: shows which chests hold it, and how many there are.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.search.ti: Any other item on the golem:
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.sorting: a chest is sorted a few seconds after it changes, never while someone has it open. Items fly out of an open side of one chest and into the next.
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.source: machines, and storage walled in on every side (it shows red).
jei.altered_aether.golem.guide.tidy: items are filed by where they come from (the Aether, the overworld...), what they are (blocks, resources, food...) and what they're made of: spruce stairs, planks and logs are all spruce. Armour, tools and weapons are kept together as equipment wherever they come from. A family that fills a quarter of a chest gets a chest of its own, and chests to spare go to smaller families of two stacks or more, though one is kept free for whatever comes next; the rest share with their kin (spruce with the other wood), and what fits nowhere finer goes with the odds and ends. A new family takes the free chest nearest its kin, and a full chest spills into the free chest beside it.
